manifest.hypothesis: Shared bounded multi-horizon evidence with covariance and capacity control produces positive, consistent beta-adjusted alpha after costs.
manifest.universe_rule: Predeclared long-history current-survivor US stocks; alphabetical alternating split. Exploratory, not point-in-time index membership.

alpha.definition: 252 times daily excess-return regression intercept; percentage points per year
alpha.uncertainty: Newey-West HAC with Bartlett weights; confidence intervals do not adjust for model search

validation.note: Calendar results are descriptive; unseen data and a frozen selection protocol are required for confirmation.

execution.note: Unfilled quantity expires at that rebalance; volume capacity uses prior 20-session median dollar volume. No order-book model.

trade_outcomes.definition: Cash-flow P&L of flat-to-flat position episodes, including partial fills and costs; open episodes excluded

methodology.execution_timing: t close signal -> t+1 open transaction -> mark at close
